meta.note: Physics-related research: OpenAlex works 2017–2026 whose main topic falls in one of 31 physics-related subfields. Countries: works with an author in that country. Institutions: the largest by those works in each country. Areas: OpenAlex subfields, sized by the institution’s works. People: authors at the institution on its 200 most-cited 2–30-author papers in these subfields plus its 200 most-cited since 2022 and the most-cited papers in its smaller areas, joined with the full OpenAlex profiles (career citations, h-index, topics) of its 200 most-cited physics researchers; up to 60 per area, ranked by h-index.
